title: Saudi Arabia: oil buffers, state-led diversification and the limits of substitution
deck: Saudi Arabia is using hydrocarbon income, state capital and logistics redundancy to widen its productive base, but fiscal dependence, private-sector productivity, labour segmentation and Gulf geography still constrain the transition.
regime: State-led diversification remains supported by oil income and large balance sheets while conflict and higher financing costs increase pressure for selective investment and private-sector productivity.
key_risk: A prolonged regional disruption or weaker project returns could force sharper prioritization before private investment and non-oil revenue are deep enough to sustain the investment cycle.

title: AI agents are becoming an operating layer for knowledge work, but governance is becoming the binding constraint
deck: Enterprise usage, privacy benchmarks and selective-autonomy research point to the same transition: the bottleneck is moving from model capability toward context control, continuous evaluation, permissions and reliable human escalation.
regime: Agentic AI is moving into real workflows faster than institutions are standardizing reliability, context governance and action controls.
key_risk: Organizations may scale delegated execution faster than they can measure privacy leakage, multi-task failure, unsafe actions and the cost of human oversight.
search_text: AI agents enterprise workflows knowledge work context integrity CI-Work CORPGEN Nature Medicine on-premise clinical agent selective autonomy NIST TEVV continuous evaluation governance

signal_rationale.delta: 2026 evidence shows enterprise agent usage moving from assistance toward delegated execution while new benchmarks and clinical research expose context integrity, multi-task reliability and selective-autonomy constraints that are not visible in simple model benchmarks.
signal_rationale.evidence: The signal triangulates provider telemetry, Microsoft Research enterprise benchmarks, a peer-reviewed Nature Medicine on-premise clinical-agent study and NIST's current TEVV work.
signal_rationale.scale_path: Scaling requires not only stronger models but identity, permissions, context segmentation, continuous evaluation, workflow-specific reliability gates, auditability and economical human escalation.
signal_rationale.transmission: Agents that can act across tools can change task composition, coordination cost, organizational design and demand for assurance infrastructure, while also creating privacy, accountability and distributional risks.
signal_rationale.falsifier: The thesis weakens if rising agent usage fails to translate into verified workflow performance, if supervision requirements scale nearly one-for-one with agent activity, or if contextual-integrity and multi-task reliability do not improve under realistic deployment.

title: Cislunar infrastructure is shifting from mission support toward a service architecture
deck: CAPSTONE, commercial lunar relays, LunaNet and new surface-infrastructure procurement show a shift toward reusable cislunar services, while power, logistics and recurring demand remain the binding constraints.
regime: Flight-proven navigation demonstrations are converging with commercial relay procurement, interoperability standards and planned service constellations.
key_risk: Institutional plans may outpace recurring demand and surface infrastructure, leaving orbital services technically viable but economically dependent on a narrow anchor-customer base.
search_text: cislunar infrastructure CAPSTONE 02 LunaNet Moonlight Altus-1 lunar relay navigation communications Moon Base NextSTEP-3 surface power logistics service architecture

signal_rationale.delta: CAPSTONE completed its extended demonstration phase in 2026 while NASA advanced a two-spacecraft follow-on, delivered navigation hardware for a commercial lunar relay, specified an initial five-satellite relay architecture and opened new lunar infrastructure procurement.
signal_rationale.evidence: The signal combines completed flight demonstration, flight-hardware delivery, contracted follow-on demonstration, service architecture, interoperability standards and current procurement rather than relying on a roadmap alone.
signal_rationale.scale_path: The path runs from autonomous navigation and relays to interoperable multi-provider services, then to persistent surface power, logistics, manufacturing and recurring multi-mission demand.
signal_rationale.transmission: If service infrastructure becomes reliable, mission design can shift from duplicating support capabilities toward buying shared communications, navigation and logistics, changing procurement, industrial organization, workforce needs and access to lunar operations.
signal_rationale.falsifier: Repeated relay delays, failure of multi-provider interoperability, weak non-anchor demand or persistent surface-power/logistics bottlenecks that prevent growth of the lunar installed base would weaken the service-infrastructure thesis.

title: Kazakhstan's transition from commodity corridor to investable Eurasian infrastructure platform
deck: Financed rail expansion, power reform and new Asian resource partnerships are beginning to connect Kazakhstan's commodity base to logistics, processing and private capital.
regime: Infrastructure-led diversification under persistent inflation and a large state footprint
key_risk: Private capital may lag public infrastructure if inflation, quasi-fiscal activity or investor-state disputes remain elevated.
watch: Middle Corridor freight and transit times
search_text: Kazakhstan strategic transition Middle Corridor rail logistics energy critical minerals Korea investment reform wages 2026
selection_rationale: Material financed rail and power investment is converging with market and utility reforms and new Korean agreements in nuclear energy, oil, critical minerals and technology. The transition is less covered than its potential effect on Eurasian trade, resource processing and private-capital mobilisation, and the transmission mechanisms run through transport costs, electricity capacity, investment conditions and household real incomes.

title: Bulgaria after euro adoption: institutional integration meets fiscal and labour constraints
deck: Euro adoption and MSCI reclassification have changed Bulgaria's institutional and market-access framework; the next test is whether fiscal dynamics, labour scarcity and shallow equity liquidity allow those changes to translate into productivity and durable market depth.
regime: Rapid institutional integration with low but rising public debt, tight labour supply and a shallow domestic capital market whose post-reclassification depth remains to be demonstrated.
key_risk: Nominal wage and spending convergence could outpace productivity and export capacity, leaving persistent fiscal and external imbalances despite stronger institutional integration.
watch: BSE liquidity and tradable share supply
search_text: Bulgaria euro adoption 2026 Eurosystem TARGET MSCI Frontier Bulgarian Stock Exchange fiscal deficit public debt current account labour shortage wage growth productivity foreign direct investment housing credit institutions capital markets Eastern Europe Balkans strategic transition

selection_rationale.relevance: Euro-area membership changes Bulgaria's monetary, supervisory, payments and collateral architecture while altering its integration with European capital markets.
selection_rationale.change: The 2026 euro adoption, full Eurosystem infrastructure integration and MSCI move from Standalone to Frontier occur alongside a weaker fiscal trajectory, tight labour supply and a wider forecast external deficit.
selection_rationale.underattention: The country remains small in global portfolios and media coverage relative to the institutional and market-access changes now occurring.
selection_rationale.transmission: The transition links monetary institutions, fiscal policy, bank and capital-market access, wages, labour scarcity, housing, external balances and household purchasing power.

title: Quantum Computing in 2026: Real Progress, Economic Utility Still Under Validation
deck: Error correction has advanced and post-quantum migration is already driving concrete decisions, but a fault-tolerant machine with independently verified economic utility has not yet been demonstrated.
regime: Measurable scientific and engineering progress without demonstrated fault-tolerant economic utility at industrial scale
key_risk: Vendor roadmaps and isolated technical metrics may be mistaken for independently demonstrated economic utility.
